summary: Strive, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to amend an existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The company increased the aggregate offering amount under its Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement from $450 million to $2.55 billion, and added seven new sales agents (Barclays, Clear Street, Benchmark, StoneX, B. Riley, Maxim, H.C. Wainwright) alongside Cantor Fitzgerald. As of June 2, 2026, the company had already sold 19,195,748 shares for gross proceeds of ~$336.4 million. Sales are made at prevailing market prices (last sale $16.12) with agent commissions up to 3.0%. No special situation — this is a routine shelf takedown/ATM registration update.
